name: mail
description: LocalMail — a super-minimal, fast, local-first, privacy-first multi-platform email client.

scripts.start: bun run engine:build && bun run tauri:dev
scripts.tauri:dev: cd apps/client && bun run build && cd ../.. && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build: cd apps/client && bun run build && cd ../.. && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && bash scripts/sign-windows.sh
